thread:
kai (release): quick heads-up: embed QPS dip ~5% in eu-west1 starting 09:40. Suspect kv-cache eviction loop. proposing hotfix deploy in 15m window.

tara (sre): ack. prefer short canary but can do expedited skip if we get 2 approvers + oncall. Need smoke list + rollback triggers.

matt (oncall): oncall ack, will monitor.

adri (eng): image: gcr.redwood/embed-svc:hotfix-6995@sha256:deadbeef. Fix toggles eviction backoff and emits evict_guard metric. Staging smoke clean.

kai (release): smoke checklist: 1) /health 200 2) p50 <= baseline + 8ms 3) evict_guard <= baseline. rollback: sustained error-rate +2% for 90s or p95 > baseline + 150ms for 2m -> pin previous sha256:beefcafe and shift traffic.

tara (sre): +1 SRE assuming smoke/rollback in place.

adri (eng): +1 ENG.
kai (release): ok we have 2 approvals. requesting expedited skip-canary. release note stub: "hotfix: prevent KV eviction hotloop in embeddings; monitoring enabled; CS notified."

releasebot: Deploy request received. Policy: expedited-skip requires ENG+SRE+oncall ack. Requirements satisfied.

deploy-bot: initiating deploy embed-svc -> sha256:deadbeef; canary skipped; rollout rl-6995000000-1; immediate traffic shift.

matt (oncall): seeing minor 429 spike at +10s then cleared. p50 looks stable.

adri (eng): evict_guard metric dropped, no regressions on staging checks.

tara (sre): watching 10m window. no rollback triggers in first 3m. silencing noisy alerts for rollout.

deploy-bot: rollout complete -> success rl-6995000000-1.

kai (release): thanks team. follow-up: create PR to add deploy-bot canary guard on 429 spikes >0.5% during canary windows. tagging eng-triage and oncall playbook update.

adri (eng): will open PR today.
tara (sre): monitors in watch mode 24h. closing thread unless we see regressions. :white_check_mark:
